title: Luxury Elie Saab Villas for Sale on the Golden Mile
summary: Situated on an exclusive development in the heart of Marbella’s Golden Mile, this unique collection of remarkable villas by Elie Saab offers the ultimate in luxury living with a contemporary design that exudes sophistication and elegance.
description:
Situated on an exclusive development in the heart of Marbella’s Golden Mile, this unique collection of remarkable villas by Elie Saab offers the ultimate in luxury living with a contemporary design that exudes sophistication and elegance.

These stunning villas by fashion designer Elie Saab feature fine finishes and construction quality, with expanses of glass, bathing the interior in natural light, and capturing captivating views of the sea, the mountains and the lush surroundings. The floor plan showcases refined interiors with two free-flowing living rooms and a gourmet kitchen equipped with high-end appliances and 5 expansive, light-filled bedrooms, all with ensuite bathrooms and walk-in wardrobes.

Large terraces, eco-friendly sustainable gardens and a stunning saltwater infinity pool elevate the outdoor living experience, creating a harmonious connection between the refined luxury interiors of the villas and the surrounding environment.

The basement level provides an inspired environment for wellness, allowing you to enjoy the ultimate experience in leisure with amenities that rival the finest resorts, including a gym, sauna and jacuzzi. Also on this level is a multi-purpose room, a three-car garage and a laundry room, together with a lift accessing the rest of the property.

These luxury villas are secluded behind private gates on an exclusive development on Marbella’s Golden Mile with a security checkpoint and motion detection technology ensuring ultimate privacy and security. Situated just a short drive from the centre of Marbella and the beach, 9 minutes from Puerto Banus and 40 minutes from Malaga International Airport, these villas offer all the benefits of enjoying an extraordinary space and optimal proximity to Marbella’s finest amenities.

These villas boast a stunning, contemporary design  to impress even the most discerning buyers designed by the Elie Saab fashion house, globally synonymous with modern luxury. These villas are perfect for those who want the best of everything, with an exceptional design, superb attention to detail and impeccable finishes.
